body:
## Change

F1. Separate diagnostics timeout from action timeout. Diagnostic completion can no longer disarm an outstanding prompt response watchdog. Lifecycle teardown clears both timers.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN simulates real allowed request order: diagnostic request, prompt response, diagnostic-only reply, timeout. Parent reviewed request eligibility and receive/teardown paths; reran 53 client/store tests.
V2. Worker contracts: 87, typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks passed.

## Limits

L1. Deterministic fake Worker/fake timer regression; not native browser scheduler evidence. Generic uncorrelated error events retain existing clear-both behavior. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(battle): isolate concurrent Worker watchdogs
